headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 7, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. In other action, the New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians 13-6, with Luis Torrens hitting 2 home runs and driving in 3 runs. The Cincinnati Reds fell to the Washington Nationals 5-3, with Cade Cavalli pitching effectively for the Nationals.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Ben Williamson (Tampa Bay Rays), who was placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain. Other players on the injured list include Cole Wilcox (Seattle Mariners), Joe Ryan (Minnesota Twins), Slade Cecconi (Cleveland Guardians), Chris Murphy (Chicago White Sox), Joey Bart (Chicago White Sox), Luis Urías (Toronto Blue Jays), and Luinder Avila (Kansas City Royals).

The trade market has been active, with several deals announced in recent days. The Kansas City Royals acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins, while the Athletics received Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for Connor Norby and Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Angels Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Athletics in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Athletics 6-5 in a closely contested matchup. Brian Serven led the Athletics' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians in Blowout Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians 13-6, securing a decisive win. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a strong performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Brewers in 5-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 5-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Gary Sánchez led the Pirates' offense with a 2-for-3 performance, including a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Pirates 6-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with multiple players contributing to the win. A.J. Ewing and Marcus Semien were among the impact hitters for the Mets, while Bryan Reynolds and Nick Gonzales had notable performances for the Pirates.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Reds 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 5-3 victory over the Cincinnati Reds in their latest matchup. Impact players for the Nationals included Cade Cavalli, who pitched effectively, while Elly De La Cruz and Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Williamson's status will be reassessed in 10 days.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals after being traded in a deal that was finalized on August 5, 2026.
